datasets.name: ds_vendor_spec
queryLines:
SELECT
  vs.*,
  s.pr,
  s.material_name
FROM
  gold.v_vendor_spec vs
    JOIN gold.v_pr_summary s
      ON s.pr_line = vs.pr_line
WHERE
  :exc_scope IS NULL
  OR size(:exc_scope) = 0
  OR array_contains(
    :exc_scope,
    CASE
      WHEN coalesce(s.exception_count, 0) = 0
        OR (s.exception_count = 1 AND lower(s.exceptions) = 'single_source' AND s.qualified_vendors > 0 AND s.vendors_with_spec > 0)
      THEN 'No exceptions'
      ELSE 'Has exceptions'
    END
  )
ORDER BY
  vs.pr_line,
  vs.test_seq,
  vs.seg_no

datasets.name: ds_pr_list
queryLines:
SELECT
  pr,
  pr_date,
  age_days,
  initcap(priority) AS priority,
  plant,
  buyer,
  category,
  replace(initcap(replace(tat_status, '_', ' ')), 'Avl', 'AVL') AS tat_status,
  tat_max_elapsed_days,
  tat_min_remaining_days,
  replace(initcap(replace(action_status, '_', ' ')), 'Avl', 'AVL') AS action_status,
  lines,
  materials,
  open_lines,
  partially_ordered_lines,
  exception_count,
  lines_with_exceptions,
  lines_without_exceptions,
  coalesce(x.has_red, false) AS has_exception_line,
  coalesce(x.has_ok, false) AS has_no_exception_line,
  CASE WHEN x.has_red THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_exception_line_n,
  CASE WHEN x.has_ok THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_no_exception_line_n,
  replace(initcap(replace(exceptions, '_', ' ')), 'Avl', 'AVL') AS exceptions,
  exception_flag,
  coalesce(x.exception_status, 'No exception') AS exception_status,
  coalesce(nullif(array_join(:exc_scope, ', '), ''), 'All') AS exc_scope
FROM
  gold.v_pr_list
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        pr,
        CASE
          WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN NOT (coalesce(exception_count, 0) = 0 OR (exception_count = 1 AND lower(exceptions) = 'single_source' AND qualified_vendors > 0 AND vendors_with_spec > 0)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'No exception'
          WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN coalesce(exception_count, 0) = 0 OR (exception_count = 1 AND lower(exceptions) = 'single_source' AND qualified_vendors > 0 AND vendors_with_spec > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'At least one line has "No exception"'
          ELSE 'Has exceptions'
        END AS exception_status,
        MAX(CASE WHEN NOT (coalesce(exception_count, 0) = 0 OR (exception_count = 1 AND lower(exceptions) = 'single_source' AND qualified_vendors > 0 AND vendors_with_spec > 0)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS has_red,
        MAX(CASE WHEN coalesce(exception_count, 0) = 0 OR (exception_count = 1 AND lower(exceptions) = 'single_source' AND qualified_vendors > 0 AND vendors_with_spec > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS has_ok
      FROM gold.v_pr_summary
      GROUP BY pr
    ) x USING (pr)
WHERE
  :exc_scope IS NULL
  OR size(:exc_scope) = 0
  OR (
    x.has_red
    AND array_contains(:exc_scope, 'Has exceptions')
  )
  OR (
    x.has_ok
    AND array_contains(:exc_scope, 'No exceptions')
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE priority
    WHEN 'NEW' THEN 1
    ELSE 2
  END,
  pr_date DESC

datasets.name: ds_exceptions_detail
queryLines:
SELECT
  e.pr,
  e.pr_line,
  e.plant,
  e.buyer,
  initcap(e.pack_category) AS pack_category,
  e.material,
  e.material_name,
  e.pr_date,
  replace(initcap(replace(e.exception, '_', ' ')), 'Avl', 'AVL') AS exception,
  e.reason,
  CASE
    WHEN s.exception_count = 1 AND lower(s.exceptions) = 'single_source' AND s.qualified_vendors > 0 AND s.vendors_with_spec > 0 THEN 'No exceptions'
    ELSE 'Has exceptions'
  END AS line_exception_flag
FROM
  gold.v_pr_exceptions e
    LEFT JOIN gold.v_pr_summary s
      ON s.pr_line = e.pr_line
WHERE
  :exc_scope IS NULL
  OR size(:exc_scope) = 0
  OR array_contains(
    :exc_scope,
    CASE
      WHEN s.exception_count = 1 AND lower(s.exceptions) = 'single_source' AND s.qualified_vendors > 0 AND s.vendors_with_spec > 0 THEN 'No exceptions'
      ELSE 'Has exceptions'
    END
  )
ORDER BY
  e.pr,
  e.pr_line,
  e.exception

datasets.name: ds_pr_materials
queryLines:
SELECT
  pr,
  pr_item,
  pr_line,
  pr_date,
  material,
  material_name,
  initcap(pack_category) AS pack_category,
  plant,
  qty,
  uom,
  replace(initcap(replace(pr_status, '_', ' ')), 'Avl', 'AVL') AS pr_status,
  replace(initcap(replace(source_type, '_', ' ')), 'Avl', 'AVL') AS source_type,
  buyer,
  category,
  replace(initcap(replace(tat_status, '_', ' ')), 'Avl', 'AVL') AS tat_status,
  tat_elapsed_days,
  tat_remaining_days,
  tat_missed_bucket,
  replace(initcap(replace(action_status, '_', ' ')), 'Avl', 'AVL') AS action_status,
  non_action_reason,
  approved_vendors,
  qualified_vendors,
  vendors_with_spec,
  replace(initcap(replace(exceptions, '_', ' ')), 'Avl', 'AVL') AS exceptions,
  CASE
    WHEN coalesce(exception_count, 0) = 0
      OR (exception_count = 1 AND lower(exceptions) = 'single_source' AND qualified_vendors > 0 AND vendors_with_spec > 0)
    THEN 'No exceptions'
    ELSE 'Has exceptions'
  END AS line_exception_flag,
  CASE
    WHEN coalesce(exception_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'No exception'
    WHEN exception_count = 1
      AND lower(exceptions) = 'single_source'
      AND qualified_vendors > 0
      AND vendors_with_spec > 0 THEN 'Single source only'
    ELSE 'Has exceptions'
  END AS exception_status
FROM
  gold.v_pr_summary
WHERE
  :exc_scope IS NULL
  OR size(:exc_scope) = 0
  OR array_contains(
    :exc_scope,
    CASE
      WHEN coalesce(exception_count, 0) = 0
        OR (exception_count = 1 AND lower(exceptions) = 'single_source' AND qualified_vendors > 0 AND vendors_with_spec > 0)
      THEN 'No exceptions'
      ELSE 'Has exceptions'
    END
  )
ORDER BY
  pr,
  pr_item

datasets.name: ds_spec_slots
queryLines:
WITH mat AS (
  SELECT
    material,
    MAX(material_name) AS material_name
  FROM
    gold.v_pr_summary
  WHERE
    :exc_scope IS NULL
    OR size(:exc_scope) = 0
    OR array_contains(
      :exc_scope,
      CASE
        WHEN coalesce(exception_count, 0) = 0
          OR (exception_count = 1 AND lower(exceptions) = 'single_source' AND qualified_vendors > 0 AND vendors_with_spec > 0)
        THEN 'No exceptions'
        ELSE 'Has exceptions'
      END
    )
  GROUP BY
    material
),
spec AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    material,
    mpn,
    manufacturer_name,
    qual_status,
    parameter_label,
    spec_text
  FROM
    gold.v_vendor_spec
),
slot AS (
  SELECT
    material,
    mpn,
    manufacturer_name,
    MAX(qual_status) AS qual_status,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY material ORDER BY manufacturer_name, mpn) AS n
  FROM
    spec
  GROUP BY
    material,
    mpn,
    manufacturer_name
)
SELECT
  m.material,
  m.material_name,
  s.manufacturer_name AS manufacturer_name,
  CONCAT('Vendor ', s.n) AS vendor_slot,
  '00 Manufacturer' AS parameter_label,
  s.manufacturer_name AS spec_text
FROM
  slot s
    JOIN mat m
      ON m.material = s.material
UNION ALL
SELECT
  m.material,
  m.material_name,
  s.manufacturer_name,
  CONCAT('Vendor ', s.n),
  '01 Qualification status',
  s.qual_status
FROM
  slot s
    JOIN mat m
      ON m.material = s.material
UNION ALL
SELECT
  m.material,
  m.material_name,
  sl.manufacturer_name,
  CONCAT('Vendor ', sl.n),
  sp.parameter_label,
  array_join(array_sort(collect_set(sp.spec_text)), ' | ')
FROM
  spec sp
    JOIN slot sl
      ON sl.material = sp.material
      AND sl.mpn = sp.mpn
    JOIN mat m
      ON m.material = sp.material
GROUP BY
  m.material,
  m.material_name,
  sl.manufacturer_name,
  sl.n,
  sp.parameter_label

datasets.name: ds_material_vendors
queryLines:
SELECT
  s.pr,
  v.pr_line,
  v.material,
  s.material_name,
  v.manufacturer_name,
  v.supplier_name,
  CASE v.vendor_role
    WHEN 'CURRENT' THEN 'Current'
    WHEN 'HISTORICAL' THEN 'Historical'
    WHEN 'HISTORICAL_NOT_QUALIFIED' THEN 'Historical, not qualified'
    ELSE 'Alternative'
  END AS vendor_role,
  v.last_po_date,
  v.po_count,
  v.qual_status,
  v.qual_due,
  v.price_status,
  v.price_text,
  v.price_validity,
  v.price_valid_from,
  v.price_valid_to,
  v.lead_time_days,
  v.standard_po_qty,
  v.source_list,
  v.manufacturer_country,
  v.storage_condition,
  v.last_po_number,
  v.last_po_qty,
  v.last_po_unit,
  v.last_po_delivery_date,
  v.last_po_created_by,
  v.has_spec,
  v.specification_no,
  v.edition_no,
  v.spec_effective_date
FROM
  gold.v_vendor_options v
    JOIN gold.v_pr_summary s
      ON s.pr_line = v.pr_line
WHERE
  v.mpn IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    :exc_scope IS NULL
    OR size(:exc_scope) = 0
    OR array_contains(
      :exc_scope,
      CASE
        WHEN coalesce(s.exception_count, 0) = 0
          OR (s.exception_count = 1 AND lower(s.exceptions) = 'single_source' AND s.qualified_vendors > 0 AND s.vendors_with_spec > 0)
        THEN 'No exceptions'
        ELSE 'Has exceptions'
      END
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  s.pr,
  v.material,
  CASE v.vendor_role
    WHEN 'CURRENT' THEN 1
    WHEN 'HISTORICAL' THEN 2
    WHEN 'HISTORICAL_NOT_QUALIFIED' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END,
  v.manufacturer_name

datasets.name: ds_buyers
queryLines:
SELECT
  buyer,
  prs,
  new_prs,
  backlog_prs,
  action_prs,
  non_action_prs,
  oldest_pr_date,
  lines,
  tat_missed_lines,
  tat_risk_lines,
  tat_within_lines,
  action_lines,
  non_action_lines,
  lines_with_exceptions,
  tat_max_elapsed_days
FROM
  gold.v_buyer_summary
WHERE
  coalesce(:pr_search, '') = ''
  OR buyer IN (
    SELECT buyer FROM gold.v_pr_list
    WHERE contains(lower(pr), lower(:pr_search))
  )
ORDER BY
  prs DESC, buyer

datasets.name: ds_pr_exception_scope
queryLines:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT
    pr,
    CASE
      WHEN
        coalesce(exception_count, 0) = 0
        OR (
          exception_count = 1
          AND lower(exceptions) = 'single_source'
          AND qualified_vendors > 0
          AND vendors_with_spec > 0
        )
      THEN
        'No exceptions'
      ELSE 'Has exceptions'
    END AS exception_scope
  FROM
    gold.v_pr_summary
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  l.pr,
  l.exception_scope,
  p.plant,
  initcap(p.priority) AS priority,
  p.buyer,
  replace(initcap(replace(p.tat_status, '_', ' ')), 'Avl', 'AVL') AS tat_status
FROM
  l
    JOIN gold.v_pr_list p
      ON p.pr = l.pr
WHERE
  :exc_scope IS NULL
  OR size(:exc_scope) = 0
  OR array_contains(:exc_scope, l.exception_scope)
